method: Toyota, Hyundai and Mazda official photographs were visually inspected before editing original Three.js geometry. No third-party photograph is redistributed or used as a vehicle skin. Dimensions and wheel sizes match vehicles.mjs; curves, trim, colours, driver eye points and simplified cabins are estimates, not OEM CAD. Rental references demonstrate fleet examples, not a most-rented ranking. Overseas left-hand-drive cabin photographs are interpreted as right-hand-drive layouts.
